card.name: Version and report numbers in citations
card.fires_on: Digits and the decimal point inside version, report or section numbers, such as 1.00, 2010-02 or 01, and the word Version itself, in document citations and course or manual references.

modes.label: Version number digits
modes.description: The point or zero within a version number after the word Version.

modes.label: Report or section numbering
modes.description: A digit or dash within a report number or numbered section heading.
modes.example: Technical report 2010-<<0>>2, Department of Computer Science, University

modes.label: Size figure in a reference
modes.description: Digits or the decimal point in a file size given beside a manual title.

card.writes: It promotes the word Revision and similar tokens, which suggests it adds revision or version-style labels.
card.plain: It fires on the numbers in version labels and report numbers in document citations.
evidence: Technical report 2010-<<0>>2, Department of Computer Science, University
